operation.body:
### Goal

Implement **FR-001**: users can submit feedback with a title and description; valid input creates one persisted item and blank fields are rejected with readable errors and preserved input.

### Acceptance criteria

- Add a `Feedback` model (or equivalent) with title and description fields, server-side presence validation, and SQLite persistence via Active Record migration.
- Provide a submission form with labelled, keyboard-accessible controls and escaped output when re-rendering after errors.
- Successful submission creates exactly one record and redirects or confirms in a way that is testable; invalid submission re-renders the form with errors and preserves user-entered title/description.
- Add automated tests covering valid submission and blank-field validation at an appropriate boundary (model and/or integration).
- Run `bin/rails test` (or documented equivalent) and report results in the PR validation section; run `bash tests/test-adapter.sh` and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`.
- Do not implement browse/sort (FR-002), categorization UI beyond defaulting uncategorized to `other` if the schema requires a category column, filtering (FR-004), or sample dataset/docs pass (FR-008) in this goal unless required for FR-001 acceptance.
- Do not edit `docs/security-review.md` or goal #3 scope.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met. Branch name must include `issue-<n>`. Keep the change reviewable in one PR.

### Out of scope

Inbox list ordering, category change flows, filters, restart persistence acceptance beyond basic create, authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, and unrelated documentation churn.

### Relevant context

Rails scaffold merged (goal #8, PR #9). Architecture: server-rendered HTML, SQLite, local-only demo. See `.ai/docs/architecture-direction.md` and FR-001 in `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md`.
